name: Attribute2
detailed_description:
This is a fun, casual third-person multiplayer battle game. You can not only defeat opponents with weapons, but your bullets can alsomodify the attributes of almost any object in the scene, including enemies' attributes, helping you turn the tide of battle and improve your chances of winning! At the same time, throughaccumulating points to earn card draws, collect cards to unlock various buffs and skills, deciding your unique playstyle! The game includes multiple maps, gameplay modes, items, characters, and weapons, providing a rich and diverse gaming experience.

In the game, you can:

  • Use a variety of weapons and characters with different abilities to defeat opponents

  • Modify the attributes of any object in the map (including enemies and yourself), such as position, size, rotation, voltage, etc., to gain a tactical advantage

  • Move, create, and duplicate objects and buildings in the scene to build your own defensive fortress

  • Earn cards through battles, unlock buffs and skills, and create your unique playstyle

  • Take advantage of the assisted aiming system to ensure every player starts fairly and enjoys smooth gameplay

  • Clarify team roles to maximize cooperative effectiveness

  • Design and share your own maps, and enjoy the fun with other players

short_description: Imagine "multiplayer shooting," "map modification," and "card progression" combined! Attribute2 is a creative shooter where bullets modify the attributes of objects and enemies, turning the tide of battle. Collect cards, unlock buffs and skills, and make each fight more strategic.
supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Traditional Chinese
